##### APPSPACE PLATFORM

# One platform.    One great workplace experience.

We get it. You want to make your workplace experience a win for every employee, whether they’re remote, in-office, or hybrid. But with so many levers in front of you, it can be overwhelming to know which ones to pull to make the biggest impact.

Imagine a platform that connects your whole workplace, from your company communications to your office spaces. **That’s Appspace.**

[Get a demo](https://www.appspace.com/schedule-demo/)

![Platform overview - Appspace](https://www.appspace.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/platform-overview-appspace1.png)

##### PHYSICAL WORKPLACE + DIGITAL WORKPLACE

## Unifying work,  wherever it happens

The office. Your living room. That café with the great Wi-Fi. Those are your physical workplaces.

The intranet. Messaging apps. Employee tools. That’s your digital workplace.

[Appspace brings them together.](https://www.appspace.com/ultimate-guide/)

Now, no matter where work happens, everyone’s connected, informed, and empowered.

With Appspace, you can:

**Bring it all together:** A single platform for your [intranet](https://www.appspace.com/intranet/), [employee mobile app](https://www.appspace.com/employee-mobile-app/), [digital signage](https://www.appspace.com/digital-signage/), [room booking](https://www.appspace.com/space-reservation/), [visitor management](https://www.appspace.com/visitor-management/), and more

**Make it all easier:** Smart insights for admins. A consumer-grade experience for employees at home, on the go, or at their desk.


**Push it all further:** Always evolving, Appspace integrates with the tools you already use — reaching every employee, everywhere.

![Great workplace experiences don’t happen by accident - Appspace](https://www.appspace.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/platformoverview-workplace-devices.png)

##### TWO SIDES OF THE WORKPLACE EXPERIENCE

## Workplace communications + workplace management

Great workplace experiences don’t happen by accident. They’re built every day through:

**Workplace communications:**
From leadership updates to team reminders

**Workplace management:** From room booking to wayfinding and visitor check-ins

![Four vertical images show: a man working late at a desk, a group in a modern office meeting, a woman smiling at her dog while working on a laptop, and a man in bike gear holding a phone outdoors.](https://www.appspace.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/unifywork-mobile.png)

## AI at the heart of your workplace

APPSPACE INTELLLIGENCE

AI is baked right into the Appspace platform — not bolted on. That means less manual work, faster answers, and content that’s always on point.

**Generative:** Speed up content creation with AI-powered writing, visuals, summaries, narration, translations, and auto-tagging.

**Conversational:** Use natural language to book rooms, find people, locate content, and get tailored responses across the platform.

**Insight-driven:** Tap into real-time data on engagement and space usage to make smarter workplace decisions.

Whether you’re communicating with global teams or managing a hybrid office, Appspace Intelligence makes it all easier, faster, and more connected.

[Learn more about Appspace Intelligence ›](https://www.appspace.com/ai/)

##### APPSPACE ORCHESTRATION

## Create your content anywhere.   Then share it anywhere.

You’ve got content to share. But it’s spread across tools — from SharePoint and intranets to signage, email, and chat. That makes it hard to keep things clear, consistent, and current.

A core capability of our platform, Appspace Orchestration unifies your communications workflow — from content creation to delivery to analytics — powered by built-in AI.

Pull content in automatically (from SharePoint, for example)

Publish it across every channel — mobile app, email, digital signage, chat

Enhance it with AI: visuals, summaries, translations, audio

Track engagement
and optimize

[See how it works ›](https://www.appspace.com/orchestration/)

PLAYS WELL WITH YOUR EXISTING TOOLS

## Integrations that fit your workflow

You’ve already invested in tools that keep your teams productive. Whether it’s Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, SharePoint, Slack, or your HR and facilities systems, Appspace pulls everything together so your workplace experience flows smoothly.

With powerful integrations, you can:

**Create once, publish everywhere —**
Easily bring content from your existing systems into Appspace without extra steps.

**Keep tools in sync —**
Real-time updates mean everyone sees the right message, in the right place, at the right time.

**Simplify management —** One platform to oversee your workplace communications, space booking, visitor management, and more.

![Integrations - Appspace technology](https://www.appspace.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/itk-integrations-appspace-mobile.png)

##### FAQS

## Questions?  **We’ve got answers.**

[What is workplace experience?](https://www.appspace.com/platform-overview/#collapse-440f4536af23b89622a3)

Workplace experience is the sum of everything employees encounter in their work environment — from the tools they use to the spaces they work in and the communications they receive. It blends the physical and digital aspects of work to support productivity, collaboration, and wellbeing.

[How is workplace experience different from employee experience?](https://www.appspace.com/platform-overview/#collapse-8f6b90d6af23b89622a3)

Employee experience covers the full journey of an employee — from hiring and onboarding to career growth and offboarding.

Workplace experience is a core part of that journey, focusing specifically on the day-to-day environment where work happens. It’s about making work feel connected and supportive — wherever your team works.

[What is a workplace experience platform?](https://www.appspace.com/platform-overview/#collapse-de39d426af23b89622a3)

A workplace experience platform brings together the tools that power your workplace — like your intranet, employee mobile app, room and desk booking, digital signage, and more — into one place. It helps you connect people, manage spaces, and communicate with your teams, all from a single platform that integrates with the tools you already use.

[Why do I need a workplace experience platform?](https://www.appspace.com/platform-overview/#collapse-1501f2e6af23b89622a3)

Today’s workplaces are more dynamic than ever — remote, hybrid, in-office, and everything in between. A workplace experience platform helps you:

- Reach every employee, no matter where they work

- Manage both digital and physical workplace tools from one place

- Improve culture, clarity, and productivity across the organization

With Appspace, you don’t just support the modern workplace — you shape a better one.

[What features should I look for in a workplace experience platform?](https://www.appspace.com/platform-overview/#collapse-6adeab86af23b89622a3)

A great workplace experience platform should bring together both communications and space management tools in one unified system. Look for features like:

- A modern intranet and mobile app

- Employee communications and digital signage

- Room and desk booking

- Visitor management

- Analytics and reporting

- Integrations with tools like Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, and more

Appspace offers all of this — so you can deliver a connected, consistent experience for every employee.

[Who uses a workplace experience platform?](https://www.appspace.com/platform-overview/#collapse-1b340ec6af23b89622a3)

Workplace experience platforms are used by a wide range of teams, including:

- Internal communications teams that need to reach everyone with clear, timely updates
- IT and digital workplace leaders who want to simplify systems and improve usability
- Facilities and workplace teams managing spaces, signage, and on-site experiences
- HR and employee experience teams building culture and improving engagement

With Appspace, all of these teams — and your employees — benefit from a single, connected platform.
